**Narrative 1.0.6** — a free, non-profit tool to build, map and rearrange stories, in English, Português, Español and Français. All your data is stored only on your computer; the app collects no data and no analytics.

The app opens Narrative and keeps itself up to date from https://hvs87.github.io/narrative/ (it works offline after the first start).

**New in 1.0.6:** On the start page, a button next to the language changes the color palette, and the welcome window shows the palettes too; the chosen palette is then used for new projects. (1.0.5 brought dragging the board with the mouse and sliding between Scenes, also with a finger.)

| System | File |
|---|---|
| **Windows** | `Narrative-1.0.6-windows-setup.exe` (installer) or `Narrative-1.0.6-windows-portable.exe` (no installation) |
| **macOS** (Intel and Apple silicon) | `Narrative-1.0.6-mac.dmg` |
| **Linux** | `Narrative-1.0.6-linux-x86_64.AppImage` (make it executable and run it) or `.tar.gz` |

The files are not code-signed. **Windows:** on the first start, choose "More info" › "Run anyway". **macOS:** right-click (or Control-click) the app › "Open", then "Open" again; if macOS says the app is damaged, run `xattr -cr /Applications/Narrative.app` in Terminal.

---

**PT:** novidades da 1.0.6: Na página inicial, um botão ao lado da língua muda a paleta de cores, e as boas-vindas também mostram as paletas; a paleta escolhida passa a ser a dos projetos novos. Ferramenta gratuita e sem fins lucrativos, em quatro línguas; todos os dados são unicamente gravados no seu computador. Windows: «Mais informações» › «Executar mesmo assim». macOS: botão direito › «Abrir». Linux: torne o AppImage executável e abra-o.
